title: Day-of Wedding Coordinator Cost: Real Prices (2026)
description: A day-of wedding coordinator costs about $764 on average (Thumbtack) or $800 to $3,000 (Zola). Plus real coordinators' own prices, checked Oct 29, 2026.
answer_html: As of Oct 29, 2026, a day-of wedding coordinator costs about $764 on average (Thumbtack). Zola puts day-of coordination at $800 to $3,000 (updated Feb 19, 2026). Real coordinators print $800 for 8 hours (Joyous Gatherings) and $1,695 (Complete Weddings + Events, Chicago).

faq.q: How much does a day-of wedding coordinator cost?
faq.a: As of Oct 29, 2026, Thumbtack puts the national average at about $764 and Zola puts day-of coordination at $800 to $3,000 (updated Feb 19, 2026). Coordinators who print their own price ask $800 (Joyous Gatherings, 8 hours), $1,695 (Complete Weddings + Events, Chicago) and $1,595 to $2,695 (the same company in Seattle).

faq.q: When does a day-of coordinator start working with you?
faq.a: Zola says day-of coordinators start about 4 to 6 weeks before the wedding, to learn your plans, meet your vendors and build the timeline. Joyous Gatherings starts planning 4 to 8 weeks out for its $800 tier and 2 to 3 months out for its $1,000 tier.

faq.q: How much is a partial or full wedding planner?
faq.a: Zola puts partial planning at $1,500 to $6,000 (updated Feb 19, 2026). In Charlotte, The Charlotte Bride lists partial planning at $2,750 to $6,000 and full-service planning at $4,250 to $10,000+ (Mar 3, 2026).

faq.q: How many hours does a day-of coordinator work?
faq.a: Joyous Gatherings includes 8 hours of wedding-day coverage in both its $800 and $1,000 tiers. Complete Weddings + Events says its day-of packages run six to ten hours, at $1,595 to $2,695 in Seattle.
Stephanie Gatton Events, a New York City coordinator, says its month-of packages start at $3,500 and most couples invest $3,500 to $4,500; it starts five weeks before the wedding date.
